Visit 3RI Technologies Angular JS Training for more details. What is Angular JS? AngularJS is well defined, powerful, and popular front-end web application framework; it mostly used to develop single-page applications. It completely based on JavaScript. Google Corporation has developed AngularJS. Since it is open-source, it maintained by Google and the community of developers and organizations whose focus is to ease and accelerate the development of single-page web applications. What is the Angular JS Applications? An application that is based-on Angular JS is a web browser-based application, which has the web pages which are generally dynamically rewritten to offer a smoother user experience. We can say, an AngularJS application is a dynamic web application that uses extended HTML and JS to develop the Web-based application. An essential need to develop AngularJS was to develop an easy approach for the Web developer. Glimpse of Angular JS Data Binding − This feature routinely synchronizes the data between the view components and the model. Scope − These are objects which discuss the model and work like a gum between the controller and the view. Services − There are singleton objects which combined as built-in services in AngularJS and are represented only once in the app. Filters − Filters select a subset of items from an array and return a new array. Directives − AngularJS has some built-in directives, which are markers on DOM elements and can be used to form custom HTML tags that work as new custom widgets. Templates − Templates are the rendered view with information from the controller and model, and they can be in the form of a single file or multiple views on one page using partials. Routing − Routing, in short, is designated as the concept of switching views. Model View Whatever − In general, MVC is a design pattern in which the application divided as a Model, View, and Controller. Rather than the conventional sense, AngularJS implements it as MVVM (Model-View-View-Model) and prefers to call it as Model View Whatever comically. Deep Linking − Deep linking allows the developer to encode the state of the application in the URL for it to bookmarked, following which the application can restore from the URL to the same state. Is AngularJS easy to learn? Yes! AngularJS is easy to learn only with the assistance of the qualified and experienced AngularJS programmers. Only 14 days are required to learn this programming language. 2. Who can learn AngularJS? To learn AngularJs, it is somehow mandatory to learn JavaScript. It will not be right to learn AnguarJs without learning about JavaScript. You need to learn the basics of JavaScript before starting learning AngularJs. 3. What is the future of the AngularJS course? AngularJs is a platform used to develop the mobile and web regarding applications. It has written in JavaScript and used to build a SPA (Single Page Application). The fact, AngularJs has become better than previous versions. There have been improvements and amendments in each component of Angular. It has now well-supported with the MVC framework. Concisely, the future of AngularJs is bright. Those who have knowledge or experience in JavaScript, learning AngularJs will be the best opportunity for them. Even, for JavaScript beginners, learning AngularJs will be a viable opportunity. Thus, go for it soon! 4. Why is AngularJS highly popular? Several reasons make AngularJs so popular such as: AngularJs data models are POJO or Plain Old Java Objects that are simple or hassle-free to amend or append properties. AngularJs offers two-way data binding that lessens the volume of boilerplate code. It is not necessary to use observable functions. Besides, AngularJs modifies the page DOM straightforwardly, it also analyzed DOM and built bindings on element attributes. In AngularJs, we use HTML for templates, which allow the developers and designers to work simultaneously. In AngularJs, it becomes feasible to structure the source code with the Model-View-Controller or Model View-Model. In AgularJs, it is possible to build a data-based web app without depending upon other framework or plug-in. The reason is, its framework has a complete package. AngularJs offers unit testing and also context-based communication. AngularJs handles any size of the project. 5. What is the average salary of an AngularJS developer? In India, the starting annual salary of AngularJs developer ranges from 5-6 lac per annum. 6. What are the prerequisites of learning angular js? The fact AngularJS is a framework for a web application. It supports HTML as a template. It also allows the developers to extend HTML’s syntax and also develop applications. However, there are some prerequisites of learning AngularJs: Understanding and experience of using HTML for web application Knowledge of MVC (Model-View-Controller) concepts Knowledge of DOM (Document Object Model) Prior experience of CSS, HTML, and JavaScript Experience in JavaScript in terms of managing events, creating functions, and error or bug handling in JavaScript-based applications. 7.
